title: Apollo 11 Landed on the Moon With 4 Kilobytes of Memory

scenes.text: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon with four kilobytes of memory.
That's the Apollo Guidance Computer, weighing about 32 kilograms.
Its program was woven by hand into wires through magnetic cores.
During the landing it overloaded and threw alarms, but restarted and kept flying.
A modern phone has millions of times more memory.
Hand-woven code put humans on the Moon. Watch it land again.

description:
The Apollo Guidance Computer had about four kilobytes of working memory and weighed about 32 kilograms.
Its program was woven by hand into core rope memory.
During the Apollo 11 landing it overloaded, restarted, and kept flying.
Would you have trusted it?
first_comment: Would you fly to the Moon on 4 kilobytes?
